'''''March of the Tuskens''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] which depicted an army of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] marching towards an unknown location, possibly for the [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|battle]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. An unknown [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] obtained this painting from an individual in [[Aurilia]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
''March of the Tuskens'' is a painting players of the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' can obtain from a [[Wikipedia:non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in Aurilia. By completing the in-game "Tusken King Heroic Encounter," players get a token which can be used to redeem this painting.
